title: EDSP Rev 1 (EOL Die Sustainment Program flyer)
supports: (via search snippet) Micross EDSP procures the LTB of die/wafers for OEMs and contract manufacturers, holds them in nitrogen for an annual storage fee under a long-term agreement for up to 20+ years, offers consignment or pay-on-demand billing, keeps authorized chain of custody and ships drop-in die or fully packaged parts from the original qualified die; no published pricing (RT-VC-DD7-02, L1 kill)

title: EOL Die Sustainment Program (EDSP)
supports: (via search snippet) EDSP purpose: continuous availability of EOL devices, avoiding re-qualification; ODM suppliers keep customer relationships while Micross holds die/wafer on consignment for an annual carrying fee and provides processing and packaged-part production (RT-VC-DD7-02)

title: Program Sustainment Management
supports: (via search snippet) Micross sells program sustainment management (BOM monitoring, LTB, storage, supplier-managed inventory) direct to OEMs (RT-VC-DD7-02)

title: August 2024 newsletter: life-cycle management with die and wafer sustainment
supports: (via search snippet) Micross markets die/wafer sustainment and LTB as a life-cycle management service (RT-VC-DD7-02)
